children: NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA, Financials), the major supplier of AI accelerators, also agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, providing the business a significantly wider footprint in the software layer that is used to construct and distribute AI models.
Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang said on Thursday that Hugging Face will remain open and users will still be able to use Nvidia computing technology.
That promise is especially important as Hugging Face has emerged as a key hub for developers to share models, datasets and AI tools across competing hardware and cloud platforms.

For Nvidia investors, the transaction expands its strategy beyond selling GPUs. Hugging Face might give Nvidia a closer view into how developers identify, train and deploy AI models while keeping access to users who might run workloads on rival processors or cloud infrastructure.

The $12.9 billion price also raises the bar for execution. Nvidia will have to prove that a large open AI platform is strategically or financially valuable enough to justify the expenditure, while not alienating developers that prize Hugging Face's neutrality.
The next catalyst is regulatory approval, and more transparency on when the deal is expected to finalize for Nvidia.

title: Nvidia Is Spending $12.9 Billion to Move Beyond the GPU
